evals.prompt: 使用提供的 Everlane 白色船领修身衬衫电商模特原图，完成六张独立高质量 Image Gen 图（正、侧、背、特写、姿态点线、相对深度风格），并建立同一可调厘米尺寸和骨骼姿态的真实人体，拟合原图动作。先用 Image Gen 给原图生成保持裁切与动作的姿态引导；拟合后把原图与实际模型渲染作为最终六图参考。保存真实三维正侧背、OpenCV叠加、人体条件尺寸及可继续编辑的完整状态。深度/姿态生成图明确为示意，另保存实际几何证据。不要用拼图裁成六图，不把先验或隐藏背面当真人测量。
evals.expected_output: Actual generated images for requested branch, one calibrated adjustable body, source-bound renders/overlays and evidence; no inflated measurement claims
assertions: The original retailer image is preserved and its source/scale provenance distinguishes observed facts from the M170 prior.
Saved centimetre parameters independently reconstruct the real neutral and posed anatomical mesh within tolerance.
Actual source-camera and front/side/back images replay from the same saved complete body and pose.
Every frozen critical original-photo region and centre scanline passes its independent envelope checks.
Visible original wrist cues and coarse limb directions do not contradict the target action; hidden wrists are not invented.
Independent actual three-dimensional views show a reference-consistent plausible action without detected severe skin overlap; coverage limitations are explicit.
Body data and reports preserve measurement definitions and prior/conditional provenance rather than claiming unmeasured real-person accuracy.
Six separate native Image Gen outputs and their actual tool receipts are retained, without collage cropping or upsampling claims.
Independent inspection confirms the generated item preserves observed product features and labels unobserved views as inferred.
